verdicts.reason: A reads left to right as a banner should (logo → can → headline/body → CTA). However, the legal copy on the left is as large as the body copy and competes with the logo. The SUNSET SALE tag and the three badges under the CTA are tiny and can't be read. There is also a stray red fragment between the can and the headline. B has worse problems. The SUNSET SALE ribbon sits on top of the can and crowds the headline, and the logo is shrunk almost to nothing. The legal text is cut off at the right edge ('for full'). The badge row and body copy are packed into a cluttered grid with no clear focal hierarchy.
